en:
ASPD <@ba.vup>+35</>; if the holder is a [Victoria] Alliance Operator, it gains the special effects of all Victorian Hammers currently on the field
<@ba.acrem>If this [Victoria] Alliance Operator also equips a "Victorian Hammer" series Equipment, that "Victorian Hammer" special effect is enhanced (doubled)</>

RES <@ba.vup>+30</>; if the holder is a [Kjerag] Alliance Operator, enemies within its Attack Range afflicted by <$ba.cold>Cold</> or <$ba.frozen>Freeze</> take Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>30%</> of its ATK every second
<@ba.acrem>If this [Kjerag] Alliance Operator also equips "Kjerag Unmelting Ice", the Arts damage per second to <$ba.cold>Cold</> or <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> enemies within its Attack Range increases to <@ba.vup>100%</> ATK</>

Initial SP <@ba.vup>+30</>; if the holder is a [Sargon] Alliance Operator, it immediately restores <@ba.vup>30</> SP when its first Skill ends
<@ba.acrem>If this [Sargon] Alliance Operator also equips "Sargon Strong Tea", each Skill activation restores <@ba.vup>3</> SP to all [Sargon] Operators</>

When equipped, the target Operator and this Equipment are destroyed and a special Refresh is performed, showing two Operators of the same tier as the holder; take one of them for free
<@ba.rem>In Team Simulation with other teammates, sends 1 copy of the original Operator to the teammate with the most Operators of the matching Alliance in the next Rest Phase</>
<@ba.acrem>If tied, it is sent randomly</>
<@ba.acrem>Cannot be equipped on custom Operators</>
Destroyed when equipped; afterward gain <@ba.vup>1</> extra Funds at the start of each Round
Destroyed when equipped; gain <@ba.vup>1</> random Operator sharing this Operator's Alliance
Destroyed when equipped; randomly take <@ba.vup>1</> Operator from the current Dispatch Center (that Operator is removed from the Dispatch Center)
Destroyed when equipped; gain <@ba.vup>2</> extra Funds next Round
ATK <@ba.vup>+40%</>; if equipped together with "Pegasus Helm", deals an additional <@ba.vup>30%</> True damage when dealing damage
HP <@ba.vup>+50%</>; if equipped together with "Pegasus Lance", restores <@ba.vup>8%</> Max HP per second.
Damage dealt within <@ba.vup>15</> seconds after deployment increases to <@ba.vup>135%</>, then gradually decays

Redeploy Time <@ba.vup>-40%</>; if the holder is a [Kazimierz] Alliance Operator, for 20s after activating its Skill, enemies within Attack Range have ASPD <@ba.vup>-35%</> and Movement Speed <@ba.vup>-35%</>
<@ba.acrem>If this [Kazimierz] Alliance Operator also equips "Kazimierz Tournament Banner", during its Skill it gains ATK <@ba.vup>+100%</> and does not retreat upon taking lethal damage, leaving the field when the Skill ends</>
ASPD <@ba.vup>+15</>; allied Operators on the left and right of the holder's facing direction gain ASPD <@ba.vup>+10</>

SP Recovery <@ba.vup>+0.2</>/s; if the holder is a [Siracusa] Alliance Operator, while in Camouflage its ATK gradually increases to <@ba.vup>200%</>, lasting until it first deals damage after Camouflage ends or leaves the field
<@ba.acrem>If this [Siracusa] Alliance Operator also equips "Siracusan Formal Suit", its first damage after losing Camouflage deals additional True damage equal to <@ba.vup>800%</> ATK</>
Destroyed when equipped; gain a random <@ba.vup>1~6</> Funds
Destroyed when equipped; the holder's Alliance Stacks <@ba.vup>+3</> (Alliance need not be active)
Holder loses <@ba.vdown>60</> HP per second; ATK <@ba.vup>+40%</>
Drag onto the field to use, then choose a Bounty to challenge
Drag onto the field to use, then gain the Operators within range (including Elite status and Equipment!)
Drag onto the field to use, then choose a special Bounty to challenge; when destroyed manually, gain 1 Funds and pass "Mystery Customer" to the next player
Each time a Skill is activated, gain <@ba.vup>8%</> ATK (stacks up to 10 times)
ATK <@ba.vup>+25%</>
ATK <@ba.vup>+50%</>; Arts damage dealt also inflicts <$ba.dt.burning2>Burn Damage</> equal to <@ba.vup>10%</> of the damage
ATK <@ba.vup>+45%</>; upon first taking lethal damage, HP cannot drop below <@ba.vup>1</> for 8 seconds
ATK <@ba.vup>+45%</>; ASPD <@ba.vup>+30</>
ATK <@ba.vup>+35%</>; if the holder is a ground Operator, attacks have a 10% chance to inflict <$ba.tremble>Tremble</> on the target for 2 seconds
ATK <@ba.vup>+60%</>, ASPD <@ba.vdown>-10</>
RES <@ba.vup>+30</>; attacks make the target lose its special abilities for <@ba.vup>5</> seconds
HP <@ba.vup>+45%</>; if there is no other Operator on the tile in front when deployed, HP an additional <@ba.vup>+25%</>
SP Recovery <@ba.vup>+0.25</>/s
Gain <@ba.vup>6</> SP when deployed; gain an additional <@ba.vup>6</> SP for each other Operator of the same Alliance
After each attack or heal, ASPD <@ba.vup>+2</> for this battle, up to 60 stacks
Attacks ignore <@ba.vup>45%</> of the target's RES
More likely to be attacked; HP <@ba.vup>+60%</>
Gains <$ba.invisible>Camouflage</> for 25 seconds after first taking damage
Redeploy Time <@ba.vup>-50%</>, HP <@ba.vdown>-30%</>
When an ammo-based Skill has 1 shot left, 60% chance to restore 60% of its ammo (up to 3 times per deployment)
Attacks have a 5% chance to inflict 1 stack of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> on the target
While HP is above 40%, immune to special statuses such as <$ba.stun>Stun</> and <$ba.frozen>Freeze</>
While blocking enemies, damage taken from units not blocked by this Operator is reduced by <@ba.vup>70%</>
Heals have a 15% chance to grant the target 1 stack of <$ba.shield>Shield</> (max 1 stack)
Attacks have a 20% chance to inflict <$ba.cold>Cold</> on the target for 1.5 seconds
Damage against targets 3 or more tiles away <@ba.vup>+50%</>
For 15 seconds after each deployment, attacks <$ba.stun>Stun</> the target for 2 seconds
Restores <@ba.vup>4%</> of own Max HP for each target attacked
Destroyed when equipped; gain <@ba.vup>2</> Funds
ATK <@ba.vup>+50%</>; Physical and Arts damage dealt is converted to <$ba.weaknessatk>Weakness Damage</>
Instantly revives when defeated during battle (only <@ba.vup>2</> times per battle)
Can be equipped by any Operator; immediately promotes that Operator to an Elite Operator
For every 7 Operators sold, gain an extra starting Operator of the holder's Alliance (not above the current Dispatch Center level)
